units: <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 43">Ex. R. s. 43</cite>, end (ref. to <he>והנחם</he>, <cite ref="Exodus 32:12">Ex. XXXII, 12</cite>) <he>תהא הת׳ מצויה לפניך</he> let reconsideration take place before thee.

<cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 326:1">Sifré Deut. 326</cite> <he>כשהמקום … יש ת׳ לפניו וכ׳</he> when God punishes Israel, he, as it were, regrets it, as we read (<cite ref="Deuteronomy 32:36">Deut. XXXII, 36</cite>) &c.; <he>ואין נחמה אלא ת׳</he> and the root <he>נחם</he> means ‘to bethink one’s self.’ <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Nedarim 9:1:6">Y. Ned. IX, beg. 41ᵇ</cite> <he>ות׳ לא כנולד הוא</he> is not regret (of a vow) like a novel (unforeseen) circumstance (v. <cite ref="N00363"><he>נוֹלָד</he></cite>, s. v. <cite ref="J00367"><he>יָלַד</he></cite>)?; a. e.
